implementationInterpretations: Qigong requires the real native SlashFullyDodged window, actual Slash-family Use with one designated/actual target, and successful native Dodge counter equal to its nonzero requirement. Damage prevention or merely requesting a Dodge is insufficient. Original native use/action/window/target and once child-return remain owned by the trigger frame.

No printed per-turn/per-phase trigger quota is invented. The requested new Slash does not debit ordinary Play Slash count, following existing requested native use semantics; this is an implementation interpretation, not an official FAQ/server claim. Its distance exemption and inability to be responded to belong only to the exact issued use and persist through its legal actor replacement, not to every Slash by that actor.

Owner may nominate itself or another living legal actor except the original target. That actor independently chooses its real material/conversion or declines. Physical, native single/multi-card conversion, Zhangba, round-once cardless, draw-funded, chained-state, requested deck, faction provider and genuine declaration adapters retain each original cost/provider/typed payment. An option must have a real execute path; no free physical Slash or private-ID sidecar is created.

Declaration success directly runs the original native Slash after real payment/challenge, bypassing neither costs nor the challenge result. False challenged failure returns the original Qigong frame without inventing a Use. Native card-use transfer retains the original physical Hand origin even when the entity is already in Processing.

Liehou first giver is another living participant within the owner actual attack range and with actual Hand cards. Both transfers are Hand-only, including a second gift of the just obtained card if still present. The second recipient differs from the giver and owner, with living/range/current Hand choices reevaluated after all first-transfer children. Equipment/approved grain are not silently treated as Hand for this skill.

The first hand transfer is a genuine paid obligation; source loss in its child does not cancel a possible second native gift by the living owner. Owner death does not invent future hand giving. Issued native Slash/state costs return once after source loss/death through exact native receipts; an invalid/dead requested actor is not issued a new unpaid card use.

Public hand payment facts contain scalar counts/bounds/seat/source/hash and no unknown received card IDs. Private exact entity IDs remain in owning typed receipts. Optional new frame fields omit null, and private receipt collections are copied read-only.

implementationNotes: Qigong native adapter identity remains recognizable after participants die, while issuing eligibility separately requires live actor/target and no winner; paid expiry can retire the exact original parent without creating future unpaid use.
Canonical private choice comparison strips only existing RequestedDeck/DrawFunded/Chained/RoundOnce native choice wrappers, retaining exact original actor and base candidates.

Native issued-use actor changes use ShownEntityUseActorMatches with original issuer/provider, preserving all original material/conversion/header checks; distance and unrespondability follow this exact current native use.

SameQigongNativeReceipt compares every CardActionContext field and collection structurally, including null-versus-explicit designated targets, then normalizes only that already-proven action reference for full record equality of all remaining fields. Owning native, issued/paid facts and attack completion use this strict comparison across cold deserialization.

Second focused evidence isolated the paid child Slash completed-window guard: child material has already left Processing while the original fully-Dodged outer Slash must retain its own material. IsQigongCompletedAttackProcessing proves exact completed paid native use, current window/action, observer lineage and precisely the retained original physical entities; root integrates only that narrow native invariant branch.

Decline permits only each original Slash material native UseFinished cleanup once, and still forbids any new requested use/payment or duplicate binding/finish. The earlier fixture incorrectly expected zero total movements after the parent continued.
The private-deck scene removes eight original AI hand cards through eight genuine selectAndMoveOwnedCard choices owned by that participant, preserving parser owner-only operation boundaries.

The private top-basic fixture follows the existing strict four-needs Slash/Dodge/Peach/Alcohol policy with two-card private viewing; the actual Qigong need still selects and pays only its requested native Slash.

Fourth focused isolated an actual empty-hand requested-deck target supply gap: all real deck cards are Slash, but the base decline-only prompt supplied zero ValidTargetSeats, which the native AssistedSlash deck chooser reads. The owning Qigong Slash-stage prompt now retains exactly its already-frozen target even before a physical Slash is selected, enabling real private deck selection without waiving legality or fabricating a target/entity.

The owning root distinguishes its canonical private ProgramTrigger from an exact native faction provider RespondSlash prompt that temporarily occupies the same top frame. The latter requires the original faction request receipt, current live provider/faction, source/target/required-card header and exact native response choices; no generic foreign chooser exception is added. Publish and own canonical validation share one frozen-target helper. Failure diagnostics identify stage, actor, prompt kind, chooser and faction presence without dumping private identities.

Seventh focused identified a mistaken fixture-independent native prompt assumption: PendingDecision.IsPrivate defaults true and AdvanceFactionSlashCandidate does not override it. The exact faction guard now requires true, matching native RespondSlash, provider seat, owner source/target, Slash incoming/required kind, empty target list and generated native response choices; all privacy and chooser checks remain strict.
